name: Hermes Agent
postCreateCommand: set -e; LOG=/tmp/hermes_setup.log; exec > >(tee "$LOG") 2>&1; echo STARTED $(date); echo Waiting for Docker...; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info &>/dev/null && echo Docker ready && break; sleep 2; done; cd ${CODESPACE_VSCODE_FOLDER:-/workspaces/7Kmcdashou}; docker compose up -d; sleep 10; docker ps; npm install -g hermes-web-ui 2>&1 | tail -5; nohup hermes-web-ui start 8648 --no-open &>/dev/null & sleep 5; ss -tlnp | grep -E 8648\|9119; echo COMPLETED $(date); echo DONE > /tmp/setup_complete
